# GetIntoFeed

> GetIntoFeed is a premier creative performance marketing agency and growth engineering studio based in New Delhi, India. We engineer high-converting digital funnels, algorithmic Meta & Google Ads campaigns, viral short-form video reels, technical SEO, brand positioning, and custom web development for ambitious consumer, D2C, real estate, fintech, and enterprise brands.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://getintofeed.com/): Official homepage with strategic growth capabilities, performance metrics, client results, and agency introduction.
- [Services Hub](https://getintofeed.com/services): Complete catalog of 8 core growth disciplines and specialized digital marketing services.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://getintofeed.com/pricing): Transparent pricing starting from ₹10,500* for single-discipline starter support, scaling to comprehensive growth sprints (₹24,999 - ₹49,999/mo*) with clear scope breakdowns, FAQs, and zero hidden retainers.
- [Case Studies & Work](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies): In-depth portfolio of verified client results, ROAS benchmarks, and full-funnel scaling case studies.
- [Feed Notes Blog](https://getintofeed.com/blog): Actionable growth insights, performance marketing tactics, SEO playbooks, and conversion engineering articles.
- [About Us](https://getintofeed.com/about): Company background, mission, leadership team (Sumit Mishra, Ashish Raghav, Shubham Mishra), and Delhi NCR studio headquarters.
- [Contact & Strategy Call](https://getintofeed.com/contact): Direct strategy inquiry form, WhatsApp desk, office address, and consultation scheduling.

## Services

- [Google Ads Management](https://getintofeed.com/services/google-ads-services-delhi-ncr): High-intent Google Search, Performance Max, negative keyword architecture, and call conversion tracking.
- [Meta Ads & Performance Marketing](https://getintofeed.com/services/meta-ads-services-delhi-ncr): Advantage+ shopping campaigns, CAPI server-side pixel tracking, and creative media buying on Instagram & Facebook.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://getintofeed.com/services/seo-services-delhi-ncr): Technical SEO audits, programmatic search architecture, entity SEO, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Website Design & Development](https://getintofeed.com/services/website-design-delhi-ncr): High-converting React SPA web architecture, sub-second edge loading, and CRO-focused UI/UX design.
- [Content & Creative Strategy](https://getintofeed.com/services/content-creative-services-delhi-ncr): High-CTR ad creative production, commercial copywriting, and brand editorial strategies.
- [Graphic Design & Branding](https://getintofeed.com/services/graphic-design-services-delhi-ncr): Brand identity systems, token design architecture, typography hierarchy, and conversion-focused vector creatives.
- [Reels & Short-Form Video Editing](https://getintofeed.com/services/reels-video-editing-delhi-ncr): Viral Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, kinetic motion graphics, and high-retention 9:16 video production.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://getintofeed.com/services/social-media-marketing-delhi-ncr): Organic social channel growth, community management, and brand distribution across major platforms.

## Featured Case Studies

- [UrbanThreads Co.](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/urbanthreads-co): Scaled D2C fashion apparel revenue by 4.2x with Meta Advantage+ and dynamic creative batching.
- [Skyline Residences](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/skyline-residences): Generated 420+ high-intent buyer inquiries for luxury NCR real estate villas via Google Ads.
- [DataSync Analytics](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/datasync-analytics): Grew B2B SaaS demo signups by 340% via programmatic SEO landing pages and LinkedIn ads.
- [VitaHealth App](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/vitahealth-app): Accelerated health tech mobile app installs to 120,000+ at 38% lower cost per install.
- [LuxeLiving Realty](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/luxeliving-realty): Premium luxury real estate lead generation campaign delivering 420+ high-net-worth property inquiries.
- [GlowUp Skincare](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/glowup-skincare): Scaled an Indian D2C skincare brand from ₹8L to ₹42L/month with viral Reels and Meta ads.
- [Apex FinTech](https://getintofeed.com/case-studies/apex-fintech): Scaled B2B qualified pipeline by +340% with high-intent Google Search ads and programmatic SEO funnels.
